# Mahadev Traders

> Mahadev Traders is a plywood, block board, flush door, MDF, HDHMR and laminate dealer and wholesaler on Gondal Road, Rajkot, Gujarat, India, trading since 1995. It sells to carpenters, contractors, interior firms, furniture workshops and home owners, with no minimum order, and delivers across Gujarat with freight quoted per order.

## Key facts

- Office: Nr. S.T. Workshop, Gondal Road, Rajkot, Gujarat 360004, India ([Google Maps](https://maps.google.com/?cid=12013598871462242283)).
- Warehouse: Nr. Poojara Mobile, Samrat Industrial Area, Gondal Road, Rajkot 360004 ([Google Maps](https://maps.google.com/?cid=863322595164647845)).
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 6355 360702. Email: mahadevtraders@hotmail.com.
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 9:00 am to 7:30 pm; Sunday 9:00 am to 12:00 pm.
- Brands stocked: Motherwood MDF (authorised dealer), Marllex (also written Marlex) plywood, block board and flush doors, Simson flush doors and block board, Zevik, Limelite and Greytone plywood.
- Minimum order: none. One sheet or one door is a normal order.
- Pricing: firm rates are quoted per enquiry by phone or WhatsApp; indicative per-square-foot bands for budgeting are on the rate guide. Freight is quoted with each order; free delivery is available on select orders.
- Regular stock: 338 plywood, block board, flush door and MDF lines, listed on the specification chart and in products.json.
